image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two feet wearing colorful, hand-knitted wool socks resting on white bedding. The socks feature a variegated yarn with orange, pink, yellow, and blue hues in a textured knit pattern (likely garter or seed stitch). The left foot is fully visible from the ankle down, showing the heel and instep. The right foot is partially visible on the right edge. The background consists of rumpled white sheets and a hint of a yellow wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, textured knit pattern (appearing to be garter stitch or similar) is clearly visible across the entire surface of the socks.
The socks use variegated yarn resulting in a multi-colored speckled appearance, satisfying the variance criterion.
